howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three steps between wanting to travel and a booked seat.

steps.title: Describe
steps.detail: Tell us where you want to go, when, and your budget. Five quick steps, two minutes.

steps.detail: Our assistant matches your request against trips that are actually available and suggests 1 to 3 options.

steps.title: Book
steps.detail: Secure your spot with a card deposit. The balance is settled directly with the agency, on site.

badges.title: Verified agencies
badges.detail: Every agency submits a business registration reviewed by our team before publishing a single trip.

badges.title: Secure Stripe payment
badges.detail: You only pay a deposit online, on Stripe's own hosted page. No card data ever passes through us.

badges.title: Responsive support
badges.detail: A question, a cancellation, something unexpected: our team responds and liaises with the organizing agency.

items.quote: Booking our Atlas trek from Paris took five minutes. The agency contacted us the same day.
items.name: Yasmine K.

items.quote: The AI form suggested exactly what we were looking for for a family trip to Djerba, within budget.
items.name: Omar T.

items.quote: Reassuring to see the agency is verified before paying the deposit online.
items.name: Leïla B.

items.a: You only pay a deposit online when booking (at least 10% of the total price). The balance is paid directly to the agency, on site or before departure depending on their terms.
Yes. Every confirmation email includes a personal cancellation link — no account needed. The deposit refund is then processed manually by our team.
Every agency submits a file (business registration, areas of activity) reviewed by our team within 48h before they can publish any trip.

items.q: Does the AI form create a custom offer?
items.a: No. It recommends trips already published by our agencies that match your criteria — dates, budget, trip type. You book a seat on an existing departure.

items.q: What happens if the agency cancels the trip?
items.a: You're notified immediately by email and your full deposit is refunded as soon as possible.

items.q: Do I need to create an account to book?
items.a: No. Booking only needs your name, email and phone. Only agencies need an account on the platform.
